CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry(hypothesis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parent_policy TEXT NOT NULL,source_run TEXT NOT NULL,family TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))<=16384),payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,registered_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding(campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,child_policy TEXT NOT NULL,hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL,control_policy TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,select_from INTEGER NOT NULL,select_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(select_rows BETWEEN 1 AND 5000),ordinal_digest TEXT NOT NULL,source_through INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(campaign_id,child_policy)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select(campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL,sample_index INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 1 AND 10),mask INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(mask BETWEEN 1 AND 1023),act INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(act IN (0,1)),hit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hit IN (0,1)),phat REAL,trace_hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(campaign_id,policy_hash,sample_index),UNIQUE(campaign_id,policy_hash,ordinal)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome(campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,child_policy TEXT NOT NULL,hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL,family TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role='SELECT'),state TEXT NOT NULL,paired_rows INTEGER NOT NULL,gain REAL,cost_penalty REAL,net_credit REAL,payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(payload AS BLOB))<=16384),payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(campaign_id,child_policy)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_quota(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(logical_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 268435456))

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_registry WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_registry WHERE hypothesis_id=NEW.hypothesis_id) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_registry WHERE hypothesis_id=NEW.hypothesis_id AND parent_policy IS NEW.parent_policy AND source_run IS NEW.source_run AND family IS NEW.family AND status IS NEW.status AND payload IS NEW.payload AND payload_hash IS NEW.payload_hash) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_hypothesis_registry BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_hypothesis_registry BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_registry WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_registry WHERE hypothesis_id=NEW.hypothesis_id) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.payload AS BLOB)))<=268435456) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_PROTECTED_STORAGE_WAIT') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_registry_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_registry BEGIN UPDATE r31_hypothesis_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.payload AS BLOB))) WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_binding WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_binding WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_binding WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy AND hypothesis_id IS NEW.hypothesis_id AND control_policy IS NEW.control_policy AND snapshot_hash IS NEW.snapshot_hash AND select_from IS NEW.select_from AND select_rows IS NEW.select_rows AND ordinal_digest IS NEW.ordinal_digest AND source_through IS NEW.source_through) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_hypothesis_binding BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_hypothesis_binding BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_binding WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_binding WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+1024<=268435456) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_PROTECTED_STORAGE_WAIT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_binding_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_binding BEGIN UPDATE r31_hypothesis_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+1024 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_select WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_select WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND policy_hash=NEW.policy_hash AND sample_index=NEW.sample_index) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_select WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND policy_hash=NEW.policy_hash AND sample_index=NEW.sample_index AND ordinal IS NEW.ordinal AND snapshot_hash IS NEW.snapshot_hash AND position IS NEW.position AND mask IS NEW.mask AND act IS NEW.act AND hit IS NEW.hit AND phat IS NEW.phat AND trace_hash IS NEW.trace_hash) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_hypothesis_select BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_hypothesis_select BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_select WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_select WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND policy_hash=NEW.policy_hash AND sample_index=NEW.sample_index) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+1024<=268435456) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_PROTECTED_STORAGE_WAIT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_select_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_select BEGIN UPDATE r31_hypothesis_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+1024 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome_insert BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_outcome WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_outcome WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_outcome WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy AND hypothesis_id IS NEW.hypothesis_id AND family IS NEW.family AND role IS NEW.role AND state IS NEW.state AND paired_rows IS NEW.paired_rows AND gain IS NEW.gain AND cost_penalty IS NEW.cost_penalty AND net_credit IS NEW.net_credit AND payload IS NEW.payload AND payload_hash IS NEW.payload_hash) THEN RAISE(IGNORE) ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT') END; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r31_hypothesis_outcome BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r31_hypothesis_outcome BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_ORIGINAL_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome_admit BEFORE INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_outcome WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_outcome WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND child_policy=NEW.child_policy) BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r31_hypothesis_quota WHERE singleton=1 AND logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.payload AS BLOB)))<=268435456) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'R31_HYPOTHESIS_PROTECTED_STORAGE_WAIT') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r31_hypothesis_outcome_account AFTER INSERT ON r31_hypothesis_outcome BEGIN UPDATE r31_hypothesis_quota SET logical_bytes=logical_bytes+(1024+length(CAST(NEW.payload AS BLOB))) WHERE singleton=1; END
